expense.title: Expense
expense.description: A financial expense logged by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

title.description: Title or merchant name of the expense.

category.description: Category for expense tracking (e.g. Housing, Food & Dining, Transportation, Utilities, Entertainment, Healthcare, Shopping, Personal Care, Education, Other).

date.description: Expense date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

paymentMethod.description: Payment instrument used (e.g. Credit Card, Debit Card, Cash, Bank Transfer).

notes.description: Optional notes or details about the expense.

isRecurring.description: Indicates whether this is a recurring monthly bill or subscription.

monthlyBudget.title: MonthlyBudget
monthlyBudget.description: Monthly budget and income configuration for monthly savings calculation.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

monthlyIncome.description: Total expected or actual monthly income.

savingsGoal.title: SavingsGoal
savingsGoal.description: A savings target or financial fund tracked by the user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Name of the savings fund or goal.

targetDate.description: Target deadline date in format YYYY-MM-DD.

category.description: Goal category (e.g. Emergency, Travel, Investment, Purchase).

/expenses/{expenseId}.description: User logged expenses with categorized amounts, dates, payment methods, and timestamps.

/monthly_budgets/{budgetId}.description: Monthly income and savings target records scoped to user and month.

/savings_goals/{goalId}.description: User designated savings goals and accumulated balances.
